note: Created from MPI-449. The eight _stage2 twins exist only because ExecutionBlocker travels downstream only AND an OUTPUT_NODE is always executed; MPI-449 fixed both forcing paths (lazy MpiBlocker 42b1540, lazy MpiSaveLatent.enabled fd9bdca) and shipped the pin in 5e9661e6, so the twins are removable. MEASURED, not assumed: the six LTX twins are 119 vs 119 nodes and a full diff shows exactly ONE differing node, Input_Is_Continue false -> true, so injecting that boolean deletes all six with no graph edits. The two WAN twins are 68->67 and 55->54, each missing Stage1_Bypass (SamplerCustom), which is the OUTPUT_NODE half and needs the lazy gate. The app resolves stage 2 by a _stage2 FILENAME SWAP in commandExecutor.js / routes/comfy.js, so that path must be removed or narrowed in the same pass or it becomes a dead branch. Test through the APP, not the browser - the browser prunes muted nodes and the app does not, which is how the original WAN bug was missed. Also sweep klein_t2i and qwen_edit, which consume MpiBlocker too.
